items.mainDefect: String#scrub is unavailable in the project's targeted Ruby 2.0, causing the feed-poll job to fail.

secondary.defect: Feeds exposing only a description leave i.content nil, so calling i.content.scrub raises an exception.

items.mainDefect: Interpolating the attacker-controlled request.referer into a JavaScript string without encoding allows script injection.

secondary.defect: Echoing the full referer URL into the response exposes potentially private query parameters or tokens.
